old_problem: The active review treated exact target, supported link-type values and power-cycle evidence as an unresolved engineering decision even though the persistent-configuration transaction and verification method are defined by NVIDIA MFT. Runtime device, port and desired-mode bindings remain necessary but need not keep the review pending.
disposition_reason: NVIDIA MFT documents mlxconfig as a persistent device-configuration tool, queryable for next-boot values, and requires a restart for successful changes to take effect; NVIDIA also documents supported-configuration discovery and textual LINK_TYPE values. ED-03 permits exact device/port/mode values as project configuration, ED-05 requires separate Ethernet and InfiniBand validation, ED-06 and ED-18 preserve the requested full OFF-to-ON-to-OS-ready power cycle, and ED-17 requires evidence before disruptive changes. No additional engineering decision is needed to define the review-layer test.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row397 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history2989 and its unique source identity.
Applied NVIDIA MFT documentation for target-bound mlxconfig query/set behavior, next-boot configuration, supported-configuration discovery and reboot activation.
Kept P1 and P2 independently mapped and verified; a single-port write or a generic device query cannot satisfy the source.
Preserved the source's power-cycle requirement as complete OFF, ON and OS-ready evidence rather than substituting an OS reboot or warm reset.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row398 and verified its manifest identity; no mlxconfig, reset, power or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: BlueField per-port InfiniBand/Ethernet link-type NVRAM activation verification
test_case.purpose: Program only the approved persistent link type for each mapped BlueField physical port and prove after a full chassis power cycle that the intended Ethernet or InfiniBand devices enumerate and operate correctly.
required_package: Approved NVIDIA MFT/mst/mlxconfig package version compatible with the exact BlueField firmware
Immutable serial/BDF/MST-device/P1/P2/physical-connector/peer map and current configuration backup
Device-supported LINK_TYPE configuration list and signed desired Ethernet or InfiniBand mode per physical port
Traffic drain, maintenance authorization, independent BMC/OOB/console and full OFF-to-ON-to-OS-ready power-cycle plan
Per-mode enumeration/link/peer oracle plus exact prior-value rollback and second authorized power-cycle recovery
test_case.test_command: Using the exact approved BDF or MST device, collect full `mlxconfig -d <device> query` and supported-configuration evidence and compare current/next-boot values with the signed P1/P2 physical map. After separate authorization of the precise delta, apply only the approved `LINK_TYPE_P1=<value>` and/or `LINK_TYPE_P2=<value>`, preserve complete output/status, and query the next-boot values. Under a separately authorized maintenance step, perform one full chassis OFF-to-ON-to-OS-ready power cycle; then query mlxconfig again and collect target-bound Ethernet `ip -details link` or InfiniBand `ibstat`/sysfs evidence for every port and peer.
test_case.expected_result: The exact device accepts only the approved P1/P2 delta, next-boot readback matches it, the chassis completes a documented OFF-to-ON-to-OS-ready cycle, and every mapped port enumerates in its signed Ethernet or InfiniBand mode with the required link/peer health and no disallowed errors or cross-port regression.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires immutable target and physical-port identity, supported-value evidence, complete before/write/next-boot/post-cycle readback, one full power-cycle trace, protocol-specific evidence for every changed and unchanged port, and a clean health/log comparison. Write success alone, one-port evidence, a reboot, or treating Ethernet state as InfiniBand evidence cannot pass.
safety_gate: Verify serial, BDF, MST device, P1/P2 and physical connector before write; never use first-device or guessed port ordering
Back up full current configuration and prove independent management before changing persistent NIC state
Authorize the exact NVRAM delta and the full power cycle as separate gates; do not combine with firmware flashing
Drain Ethernet and InfiniBand traffic and preserve complete logs/readback before any power action
Stop on target mismatch, unsupported value, failed readback, unexpected port loss, boot failure or OS-not-ready timeout; never auto-retry
expected_evidence: Serial/BDF/MST/P1/P2/connector/peer map, MFT and firmware versions and supported LINK_TYPE evidence
Full pre-state backup and signed current-to-desired per-port delta
Complete mlxconfig set output/status and next-boot readback for both ports
BMC/chassis OFF, ON, boot and OS-ready timestamps for the authorized power cycle
Post-cycle mlxconfig plus separate Ethernet and InfiniBand enumeration/link/peer evidence per port
Health/log comparison, recovery record if invoked and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: If write readback is wrong, do not power-cycle; restore the saved values if explicitly authorized and preserve evidence. If post-cycle mode, enumeration or boot is wrong, stop, use BMC/OOB, apply only the approved prior P1/P2 values and perform one separately authorized full power cycle, then verify all ports and OS readiness. Never retry automatically.
